title: Uji Tarik Kawat Duri Diamond di Pagar Kebun
hook: Kawat duri murah lapisan galvanisnya tipis jadi baru satu musim hujan sudah berkarat
story: Di batas kebun, tiga baris Kawat Duri Diamond sudah terpasang di antara dua tiang kayu dan satu roll bersegel tergeletak di pangkal tiang. Pekerja mencengkeram kawat baris tengah dan menariknya kuat ke arah badan; kawat tetap tegang, duri tidak kendor dan tidak ada serbuk karat saat diusap sarung tangan. Ia lalu menunjuk roll Diamond dan meminta penonton menyimpan video sebelum belanja kawat batas kebun.
caption:
Kawat duri murah lapisan galvanisnya tipis jadi baru satu musim hujan sudah berkarat. Diamond durinya rapat dan kawat tetap tegang waktu ditarik kencang, spek lengkapnya tanya lewat DM.
#kawatduridiamond #pagarkebun #kebunsawit #materialbangunan

creative.action: Menarik kawat baris tengah sekuat tenaga ke arah badan, mengusap duri dengan sarung tangan, lalu menunjuk roll Diamond di pangkal tiang
creative.selection_reason: Satu aksi tarik yang bisa diperiksa frame awal sampai akhir, produk resmi terlihat sejak detik nol, dan tidak butuh alat tambahan yang bisa muncul-hilang di tengah take.
creative.dialogue: Kawat murah lapisan galvanisnya tipis, baru satu musim hujan sudah berkarat. Diamond durinya rapat, ditarik kencang tetap tegang. Simpan dulu sebelum beli.

shots.prompt: Photorealistic live-action video, vertical 9:16, 12 seconds, one continuous take, shot on a smartphone vlog camera at 24 fps held at chest height with a gentle natural handheld sway and a slight three-quarter angle toward the fence. Location: a palm-oil plantation boundary in North Sumatra with dry grass, red earth and rows of oil palms blurred behind, bright overcast morning light from the open sky. The fence has exactly three horizontal strands of the product in the single attached official reference photo: galvanised barbed wire with tight four-point barbs and a glossy zinc finish, strung between two dark hardwood posts about four metres apart. One sealed roll of the same barbed wire with its oval BARBED IRON WIRE label, red gear cap logo and DIAMOND emblem leans upright against the base of the left post. An Indonesian male farm worker about 38 years old in a faded dusty blue long-sleeve work shirt, dark work trousers, grey cotton work gloves and a brown field cap stands at the fence; his face, gloved hands and torso stay in frame the whole take. PROP CONTINUITY RULE: from 0.0s to 12.0s exactly three strands of barbed wire and the one labelled roll at the base of the left post are already visible and remain visible; no pliers, hammer, machete, bucket, vehicle, animal, extra person or extra wire roll may appear, move in, fall or disappear at any instant, the barb spacing must not change and no barb may detach. BEATS: at 0.0s he already grips the middle strand with both gloved hands and pulls it hard toward his chest, the strand stays taut and does not sag or snap, while he speaks Indonesian with accurate lip sync, "Kawat murah lapisan galvanisnya tipis, baru satu musim hujan sudah berkarat". From 3.6s he eases the pull, runs his gloved thumb and forefinger slowly along the barbs and turns the strand slightly toward the lens, the zinc surface stays bright with no rust dust, as he says, "Diamond durinya rapat, ditarik kencang tetap tegang". From 8.0s he lets go, steps back half a pace, points at the labelled roll at the base of the left post and looks into the lens saying, "Simpan dulu sebelum beli". From 10.8s to 12.0s he holds still with the taut middle strand and the labelled roll both fully in frame. Ambient only: light wind in the palms, faint birds, dry grass rustle, no music. Shot on smartphone vlog camera, natural clean daylight neutral white balance 5500K, true-to-life colours, realistic matte human skin with visible fine pores and real micro-texture, no plastic shine, no waxy skin, no glass skin, no yellow or orange tint, no artificial golden glow, zero CGI, authentic non-AI documentary look. Completely clean frame: zero on-screen text, zero subtitles, zero captions, zero HUD, zero timestamps, zero watermark, zero added logo beyond the printed label already on the product roll.

trend_sources.title: Barbed wire standards: ASTM A121 and the Class 1 vs Class 3 coating that decides field life
trend_sources.evidence: Dibaca 20 November 2026 pukul 10.04 WIB dari hasil pencarian: standar ASTM A121 membedakan kelas lapisan seng kawat duri, Class 1 sekitar 0.28 oz/ft2 dengan umur lapangan 2 sampai 12 tahun, Class 3 sekitar 0.80 oz/ft2 dengan umur 13 sampai 30 tahun, dan kawat yang hanya ditulis galvanized tanpa kelas hampir selalu kelas paling tipis. Ini dasar klaim bahwa lapisan galvanis tipis menentukan cepat atau lambatnya karat.

trend_sources.title: Class 1 vs Class 3 Galvanized Fence Wire: Which Lasts Longer
trend_sources.evidence: Dibaca 20 November 2026 pukul 10.05 WIB dari hasil pencarian: kawat impor tanpa label kelas sering di bawah 0.25 oz/ft2 dan mulai berkarat dalam 3 sampai 6 tahun, sedangkan Class 1 bisa 8 sampai 10 tahun di iklim lembap. Dipakai sebagai konteks mengapa kawat berlapis tipis cepat berkarat di kebun, bukan sebagai angka resmi produk lokal.

trend_sources.title: Kawat Duri Surabaya
trend_sources.evidence: Dibaca 20 November 2026 pukul 10.06 WIB dari hasil pencarian: spesifikasi kawat duri galvanis yang beredar di pasaran Indonesia menyebut diameter kawat 2.1 mm (BWG 14), jarak antar duri 10 cm, panjang roll sekitar 100 meter dan berat sekitar 10 kg. Dipakai sebagai pembanding umum kerapatan duri, bukan spesifikasi resmi Diamond.
